title: Never expose private Taria resources through Tarium projects
abstract: Do not publish, link, import or require private Taria resources, conversations, histories, unpublished research, internal paths or nonpublic dependencies in a public Tarium project without separately authorized publication of appropriate material.

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only explicitly authorized work on independent public Tarium projects

remarks: Public-source rule normalization reviewed as a distinct project-specific atom; overlapping general rules retained.
